overview: We review flagged and risky orders before they leave your warehouse. For each one we check your platform's risk analysis, address and billing match, order size and history, and how the payment was made, then recommend ship, hold or contact the customer. We also look at failed and disputed payments for patterns. You get a short set of rules your team can follow. We cannot catch every case, but we help you decide with more facts.

faq: No. Nobody can. We make a careful review with the facts available and recommend what to do, and the final choice to ship or cancel stays with you.
Do you access my payment provider account?
Only the part you choose, with a staff role that limits what we see. We never ask for card data, passwords or bank logins.
What about real customers who look risky?
That is why we recommend a polite verification message for borderline cases rather than a plain cancel. This protects genuine buyers while you check.
Which platforms and fraud tools do you use?
Shopify's own risk analysis, Stripe Radar, PayPal tools and common fraud apps. We use whatever is already on your store, or suggest a low-cost one if nothing is set up.
